verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe has an Issuing balance that can be funded from an external bank via Dashboard or API, and that it claims "full transaction visibility" alongside real-time authorization decisioning. These are the product's own capabilities touching this story, but they are thin. Nothing in the pack documents real-time balance views, a ledger linking each authorization to its clearing, or settlement reporting for reconciliation. Missing for 10: real-time account/card balance reporting, authorization-to-clearing transaction ledger linkage, settlement/reconciliation reports, independent corroboration.
